mapper.select: SELECT user_id,idem_key,request_hash,food_id,created_at,expires_at FROM food_create_idempotency WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND idem_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM food_create_idempotency WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND idem_key=#{key} AND expires_at <= #{now}
mapper.update: UPDATE food_create_idempotency SET food_id=#{foodId} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND idem_key=#{key} AND food_id IS NULL
